MRI  KNEE  -  LEFT

TECHNIQUE:  Unenhanced multiplanar multisequence MR images of the knee.

CLINICAL INDICATION:  Pain and? Inflammatory arthritis

COMPARISON:  Knee radiograph [Date]

FINDINGS:

Medial meniscus:  Diminutive and irregular posterior horn consistent with complex tear. There is peripheral extrusion of the medial meniscal body.

Medial compartment articular cartilage:  Mild cartilage thinning of the surface of the medial distal femur. Mild to moderate cartilage thinning of the intra-articular medial proximal tibia. No underlying osseous edema.

MCL:  Intact.

Lateral meniscus:  Intact.

Lateral compartment articular cartilage:  Intact.

LCL complex:  Intact.

ACL:  Intact.

PCL:  Intact.

Quadriceps and patellar tendons:  Intact.

Patellofemoral alignment:  Normal. 

Patellofemoral cartilage:  There is thinning and fissuring of articular cartilage particularly along the patellar apex and lateral patellar facet as well as along the medial femoral trochlea.

Joint effusion:  Trace. No synovitis.

Intra-articular bodies:  None.

Bone marrow:  Normal.

Popliteal fossa:  Normal.

Other findings:  None. No erosions or periostitis. No tenosynovitis.


INTERPRETATION:
1. Complex tear posterior horn of the medial meniscus with peripheral extrusion of the medial meniscal body.
2. Moderate chondrosis medial femorotibial and patellofemoral compartments consistent with moderate osteoarthritis of the left knee.
3. No specific imaging features of active inflammatory arthritis.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Síndrome meniscal interna rodilla izquierda.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
El menisco lateral es de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos de rotura.
Aumento de señal central del cuerno posterior y parte del cuerpo del menisco medial que no
impresiona contactar con la superficie articular, sin caracteres propios de rotura.
Cartílagos de los compartimentos femorotibiales y de la tróclea femoral sin alteraciones.
Condropatía rotuliana superficial difusa de predominio medial.
Aumento de señal del aspecto superoexterno de la grasa de Hoffa.
No hay evidente derrame articular ni quistes poplíteos patológicos.
Tendones cuadricipital, rotuliano, tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial
dentro de límites normales.
Aumento de señal de la región insercional del gastrocnemio medial en su región periférica, con
discreto edema las partes blandas regionales. También se observa laminar cantidad de líquido
entre los tendones de la pata de ganso y el cóndilo femoral medial.
Impresión:
Condropatía rotuliana superficial.
Signos de un síndrome de hiperpresión externa de la rótula.
Probable tendinosis insercional del gastrocnemio medial asociado a fenómenos de fricción
posteromedial de la rodilla

FINDINGS:

Fluid:
No joint effusion. No popliteal cyst.

Medial compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament, cartilage):
No meniscal tear. There is partial-thickness cartilage thinning at the central weightbearing portion of the medial femoral condyle, up to high grade laterally and full-thickness cartilage fissures seen posteriorly in the nonweightbearing portion, with reactive subchondral marrow changes. Medial collateral ligament unremarkable.

Lateral compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament complex, cartilage):
There is a longitudinal horizontal tear of the lateral meniscus body. No displaced meniscal flap. Diffuse mild cartilage thinning at the lateral femoral condyle, with superimposed high-grade cartilage fissures at both the lateral femoral condyle and lateral tibial plateau. There are no reactive subchondral marrow changes. Lateral supporting structures are intact.

Intercondylar compartment (anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments):
Normal

Anterior compartment (extensor mechanism, cartilage, Hoffa's fat pad):
Full-thickness cartilage thinning and fissuring at the trochlea inferiorly, with prominent reactive subchondral marrow changes and cysts. The patella demonstrates mild to moderate cartilage thinning and fissuring without reactive subchondral marrow change. Tendinosis of the distal quadriceps tendon, without tear.

Bones:
As above

Muscles and neurovascular structures:
Normal.

Other findings:
None

CONCLUSION:

Horizontal tear of the lateral meniscal body. No displaced meniscal flap.

Tricompartmental chondropathy as described above.

Distal quadriceps tendinosis, without tear.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Intermittent pain walking up and down the steps for one month.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.. Tricompartmental marginal osteophytes.

JOINT SPACE:
Moderate joint effusion with synovitis. No intra-articular bodies. Trace Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Complex tear medial meniscus posterior root, posterior horn, and body including a radial tear at the posterior root with moderate extrusion of the body into the meniscotibial recess.
Medial compartment cartilage: Full thickness cartilage denudation throughout the medial weightbearing surfaces with subchondral cystic change marrow edema.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Degenerative/globular signal at the posterior root lateral meniscus without tearing.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Mild cartilage heterogeneity fissuring.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Full thickness cartilage loss and medial patellar facet extending to the median ridge with subchondral marrow edema at the median ridge. High-grade cartilage loss at the medial trochlea.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 10 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Complex tear medial meniscus posterior root, posterior horn, and body including a radial tear at the posterior root with moderate extrusion of the body into the meniscotibial recess.
2.	Tricompartmental osteoarthritis, severe in the medial and patellofemoral compartment.
